data.one_liner: Detect screenshots and screen recording on iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to detect when a user takes a screenshot or starts/stops screen recording on iOS. It provides callback mechanisms and status checks to handle insecure screen events.
use_when: You need to detect screenshots taken by users on iOS.
You need to monitor screen recording status changes on iOS devices.
You want to secure sensitive content by reacting to screen capture events.
avoid_when: You need screenshot or screen protection for Android (requires other packages like flutter_windowmanager).
You only need cross-platform device information without capture detection.
strengths: Detects both screenshots and screen recordings on iOS.
Provides methods to check current screen recording status (`isCaptured`).
Simple API with initialize, listener, and dispose methods.
weaknesses: Works only for iOS (Android is not supported by this package).
Screen recording detection only works on iOS versions above 11.0.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the plugin in initState and dispose of it when exiting the screen.
